description: This file contains unit tests for the PatientValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically for validating Patient objects. It extends PersonValidatorTest and uses JUnit 5 assertions to test various validation scenarios related to patient identifiers, gender, and field lengths.

classes.name: PatientValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the PatientValidator in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the validator object for the test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAPreferredPatientIdentifierIsNotChosen
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if a patient has identifiers but none is marked as preferred.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAPreferredPatientIdentifierIsNotChosenForVoidedPatients
methods.description: Ensures validation fails for voided patients without a preferred identifier.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailWhenPatientHasOnlyOneIdentifierAndItsNotPreferred
methods.description: Confirms validation passes when a patient has a single identifier that is not preferred.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfGenderIsBlank
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the gender field is blank.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies validation passes for correct field lengths and valid data.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when fields exceed expected length constraints.
